name: fiction-craft-skills
description: Skills for writing fiction with an AI: craft frameworks (plot, character, magic and worldbuilding, scene craft) plus a guided process from idea to revised chapter. You choose how much the AI writes, from everything to nothing.

interface.shortDescription: Craft frameworks and a guided process for writing fiction with an AI
interface.longDescription: Plot, character, magic and worldbuilding, and scene craft frameworks, plus a guided process: develop the idea, plan, draft, check, and revise. You choose who writes each stage, from the AI doing everything to the AI only checking your work.
defaultPrompt: What should I do next with this story?
